title: MONICA: REAL-TIME MONITORING AND CALIBRATION OF CHAIN-OF-THOUGHT SYCOPHANCY IN LARGE REASONING MODELS

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating model predictions on multiple-choice reasoning benchmarks (AIME, GPQA, MMLU) by comparing responses to cued prompts containing misleading information (e.g., metadata leakage, user suggestions, validation functions) against no-cued prompts. The evaluation uses metrics such as Resistance Rate (RR), Persistent Ratio (PR), Sycophantic Rate (SR), and Mislead Rate (MR).
